name: Open-Faced Portobello Melts with Tomato-Onion Jam & Sweet Potato Fries

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sweet potatoes
6 caps portobello mushrooms
6 tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Peel and slice potatoes into ¼-inch thick strips. Place in a large bowl and add oil and salt; toss to coat and spread out between two baking sheet pans. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping once, until golden and fork-tender, about 30 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice mushrooms into ½-inch thick pieces; place in the bowl used for the potatoes, add oil and salt, then toss to coat. Spread out on a third large baking sheet pan, add to the oven, and roast until soft, 12-15 minutes. Remove mushrooms to a plate to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and thinly slice the onions.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onions to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, medium dice tomatoes. Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.

Add tomatoes, half the basil, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes break down and the sauce thickens, 6-7 minutes. Reserve remaining basil for garnish.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wipe the baking sheet pan used for the mushrooms dry, then cut the buns in half and place them on the pan. Toast in the oven until golden brown, 3-4 minutes.

instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Spread each bun half with mayo, then top with the tomato jam, mushrooms, and mozzarella. Return to the oven and bake until the cheese melts, about 6 minutes.
To serve, divide the melts and sweet potatoes between plates. Sprinkle melts with reserved basil and enjoy!
